lgd_definition: “Working Farm Dog” shall mean a dog that is specifically trained to work and live with domestic farm animals without causing them harm while aggressively repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose and belongs to one of the breeds defined as a Working Dog by the Canadian Kennel Club.
collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog shall securely fasten on the collar of the dog the tag issued by the Township.
dog_limit: Limit of two (2) dogs in a dwelling unit.
notes: Farm-friendly bylaw. The Township recently updated its Canine Control By-law to 2025-10. It explicitly defines 'Working Farm Dog', distinguishing them from regular domestic pets, though they are subject to standard licensing and the standard limit of 2 dogs. Unlike the previous 2017 bylaw which allowed up to 4 working farm dogs on agricultural properties, the 2025 bylaw removes this specific exemption unless a Kennel License is obtained.

lgd_definition: “Working Dog” shall mean a dog trained, kept and utilized for work purposes including, but not limited to, livestock handling and/or guarding, pest and predator control, recreational dog sled use and police or rescue dogs.
collar_tag_req: Except as provided herein, no person shall harbour a dog or dogs within the boundaries of the Town, unless such dog has affixed to it a current dog tag issued under this By-law.
dog_limit: No person shall keep or harbour more than three dogs at any one time in a dwelling unit or on any individual conveyable land entity located within the boundaries of the Town.
notes: Farm-friendly bylaw. Includes a specific definition for 'Working Dog' which explicitly includes livestock handling, guarding, and pest/predator control. However, there are no specific exemptions to the 3-dog limit or licensing fees provided for working dogs.

collar_tag_req: The owner shall keep the dog tag securely fixed on the dog at all times. Dogs engaged in hunting under the control of their owner may have tags and collar removed during the hunt.
dog_limit: No person shall keep, or do anything, which may cause to be kept, more than three (3) dogs and six (6) cats on any lot within any hamlet.
notes: Note: The municipality was listed as 'dawn' in the prompt, but the provided URL explicitly belongs to the Township of Addington Highlands. It is a standard animal control bylaw that explicitly allows collar/tag removal for hunting dogs while actively hunting, but contains no mentions or exemptions for working farm dogs or LGDs.

lgd_definition: “Farm Dog” – means a dog whose role is to actively heard/guard livestock, such as cattle or sheep, on an agricultural property;
collar_tag_req: Every Owner of a Dog shall cause a Dog tag to be securely affixed on the Dog at all times (until the tag is renewed or replaced).
dog_limit: Maximum Number of Dogs Per Dwelling: Subject to the provisions of this By-law, no person shall keep or permit to be kept, more than three (3) Dogs on his or her property.
notes: Farm-friendly bylaw. It includes a specific definition for 'Farm Dog' that encompasses both guarding and herding livestock. It also provides a farm-friendly containment exemption, allowing dogs on farms to be restrained by 'any reasonable means that prevents the Dog from being At Large' rather than strictly requiring a physical fence or chain.

collar_tag_req: The Owner of a Dog shall keep the Dog tag securely affixed on the Dog for which it was issued until renewed or replaced.
dog_limit: No more than a maximum of three (3) dogs are permitted per household and all must be licensed.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw. Contains no specific provisions, definitions, or exemptions for livestock guardian dogs or farm dogs. Properties with more than 3 dogs must meet zoning provisions and acquire a Kennel licence.

lgd_definition: “Farm Dog” or “Farm Cat” means a Dog that is trained and kept for the purpose of controlling or protecting livestock and poultry or a Cat that is kept for the purpose of rodent control within a privately owned barn or farm building.
collar_tag_req: Every Owner shall affix to his or her Dog or Cat a license tag, consisting of a metallic plate having raised, cast or stamped thereon figures indicating the year of issuance... and shall keep such tag affixed.
dog_limit: The number of permitted Dogs and Cats within each Zone of the Municipality, as defined in Section 2.1 of the Zoning By-Law 2014/45, shall be as follows (keeping more than permitted number of Dogs is an offence).
notes: Farm-friendly bylaw. Features a specific definition for 'Farm Dog' explicitly covering dogs trained and kept for the purpose of controlling or protecting livestock and poultry. Municipal news articles indicate the municipality maintained a limit exemption for livestock guard dogs when it reduced pet limits for urban areas in 2020.

lgd_definition: “Livestock Guardian Dog” (LGD) is a dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals or livestock (e.g. cattle, sheep, poultry) to protect them while repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
herding_definition: “Herding Dog” means a dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposes of controlling livestock on the farm.
collar_tag_req: Dog tags will be valid for the life of the dog for which they are issued.
dog_limit: Maximum of two (2) dogs within urban areas, and three (3) dogs within rural areas. Exemption: In a Rural area, a person may harbor more than 3 dogs at a premises without a kennel license, provided the person is keeping sheep upon the same premises... the person provides proof of producer registration issued in the name recorded by the Ontario Sheep Marketing Agency; and the dogs are LGDs and or herding dogs.
notes: Highly farm-friendly bylaw. It explicitly defines both 'Livestock Guardian Dog' and 'Herding Dog'. Most notably, it features a unique agricultural exemption allowing more than 3 dogs on rural properties without a kennel license specifically for LGDs and herding dogs, provided the owner keeps sheep and provides proof of Ontario Sheep Marketing Agency registration.
